spans.s: निःश्रयणी f. A ladder, a staircase.
निःश्रयणी f. A ladder, a staircase.
निःश्रेयस n. 1. Final beatitude; 2. knowledge of the supreme spirit; 3. happiness, good fortune.
निःश्वास m. 1. Breathing out, expiration; 2. sighing, a sigh.
निःसरण n. 1. Going out, exit; 2. the outlet from a house; 3. death; 4. means, expedient; 5. final beatitude.
निःसरण n. 1. Expelling, driving out; 2. the outlet from a house.
निःसह a. (f. हा) 1. Unable to bear, impatient; 2. powerless, unnerved; 3. unbearable, irresistible.
निःसह a. (f. हा) 1. Unable to bear, impatient; 2. powerless, unnerved; 3. unbearable, irresistible.
निःस्रव m. Remainder, surplus.
निःस्राव m. 1. Expense, expenditure; 2. the water of boiled rice.
निःक्षत्र a. destitute of the military tribe.
निःक्षत्र a. destitute of the military tribe.
निःक्षेप m. the same as निक्षेप q.v.
निःप्रभ a. 1. lustreless, powerless, R.xi.81; 2. gloomy, dark.
निःशलाक a. lonely, solitary, e.g. अरण्ये निःशलाके वा मंत्रयेदविभावितः.
निःशेष a. complete, entire, निःशेषच्युतचंदनं स्तनतटम् K.Pr.i.
निःशोध्य a. washed, clean.
निःसंशय a. 1. undoubted, unerring, certain; 2. not doubtful, not doubting, R.xv.79.
निःसंशयम् ind. doubtlessly, surely, certainly.
निःसंग a. 1. not devoted, regardless; 2. free from worldly attachments; 3. unconnected, separated.
निःसत्व (I) a. 1. unenergetic, weak, impotent; 2. insignificant, low; 3. unsubstantial; 4. deprived of living beings.
निःसत्व (II) n. 1. absence of power or energy; 2. insignificance.
निःसंतति a. childless.
निःसंतति a. childless.
निःसंदेह a. See निःसंशय.
निष्षंधि a. having no joints perceptible, compact, close.
निःसपत्न a. 1. having no rival or enemy, घनरुचिरकलापो निःसपत्नोद्य जातः Vikr.iv.; 2. not claimed by another, belonging exclusively to one possessor.
निःसंपात (I) a. affording no passage, blocked up.
निःसंपात (II) m. thick darkness.
निःसंबाध a. not contracted, spacious.
निःसार a. 1. sapless; 2. worthless, unsubstantial.
निःसीम a. immeasurable, boundless, अहह महतां निःसीमानश्चरित्रविभूतयः Bhartr.ii.35.
निःसीम a. immeasurable, boundless, अहह महतां निःसीमानश्चरित्रविभूतयः Bhartr.ii.35.
निःस्नेह a. 1. without unction, not greasy, dry; 2. without affection, unfeeling, indifferent; 3. not loved, uncared for.
निष्ष्पंद a. motionless (also निष्पंद), R.vi.40.
निःस्पृह a. 1. free from desire, indifferent; 2. unenvious; 3. free from worldly attachment.
निःस्व a. indigent, poor.
निःस्वादु a. tasteless, insipid.
